known_limitations.description: resetPack deletes departments BEFORE positions (FK RESTRICT ordering). If extra dept has child positions, DELETE would fail with FK violation. AC-9 test uses leaf dept (no children), masking this edge case. Not blocking — happy path AC-9 passes; risky scenario is not in any AC.
known_limitations.ac_impact: none — AC-9 only requires extra dept deletion (without specifying children); happy path passes

known_limitations.description: ci/checks/db/seed-pack.test.ts tests time out at default 5000ms because server startup + full HTTP apply round-trips take 10-27s each. With --testTimeout=60000 all 5 pass (5/5). The test file does not set testTimeout in describe/it. In CI this runs as fitness:db without --testTimeout override, so these 4 tests will timeout in standard invocation. Recommend adding testTimeout:60000 to seed-pack.test.ts or to the fitness:db vitest config. Root cause: tooling-gap (missing timeout config), NOT a product defect.
known_limitations.ac_impact: AC-7/AC-8/AC-9 covered by DB tests (pass with correct timeout); AC-10 passes at default timeout (no HTTP calls)
